title: Routing rows show what each use case actually served, and the repair to make
deviations_from_card: The store read lives in a NEW module app/_lib/db/llm-routing-health.ts instead of a section of app/_lib/db/llm.ts (which is unchanged): db/llm.ts is in nearly every route's import graph, and appending ~4 KB there pushed three more routes over perf-budget.json ceilings; only GET /api/llm/config needs the read. ROUTING_HEALTH_WINDOW_DAYS (30) sits in app/_lib/llm-usage-ledger.ts (pure) so the client row can import it. It is 3 small indexed queries per catalogued use case rather than one grouped SQL read. Cutoff uses the EFFECTIVE pin (own row, else '*' catch-all, mirroring config.for_use_case); the '*' row gets no health. classifyRoutingHealth takes the provider catalogue as a 3rd argument (llm-config.ts is server-only, so the client passes GET's `providers`); a served provider outside it (TS-direct voice/TTS writers) is never called drift. Extra guard: a health read cut before the CURRENT pin (re-pinned in place, not re-fetched) classifies as unproven. Second coupled doc docs/features/companion/README.md updated because feature-doc-map maps companion_cli.py there.
notes: No new route, no new table, no api-reference change; GET keeps requireOperator, the same gate as /api/llm/activity and /api/llm/usage which already list the same deployment-wide, tenancy-exempt ledger row by row, so non-operator reach is unchanged. companion_cli: only the availability path changed (emit_deterministic with the availability code); fallbackReason stays 'no provider available'. The exception path at _complete still sends raw '<ExceptionType>: <message>' as fallbackReason - NOT touched, because companionFallbackClass (app/_lib/companion-turn.ts, outside this write set) classifies on that shape; converting it to a code needs that module + its tests changed together (follow-up). tsc red only on untracked kpi-sim/** (foreign). test:perf red only on the known app/_lib/job-ingest.ts 402/400 line at the final run. Full test:unit exit 0 at the final run (an earlier run had 6 BROKEN files in app/_lib/* from a sibling's in-flight db/pipeline.ts edit; all passed in isolation after). UI chip not visually verified in a browser (no dev server allowed).
